_comment: Reference sheets. Render with comic_render.py --queue out/sheets.json.

jobs.prompt: a clean reference sheet on white paper. Style: black and white comic strip panel, scratchy crow-quill pen and ballpoint ink on cardstock, harsh photocopy contrast, heavy black spotting, jagged uneven line weights, 1990s indie comix zine style, xerox grain, no color, no gray tones. model sheet of a seventeen-year-old girl with heavy smudged black eyeliner, straight dark shoulder-length hair, an oversized black cardigan, a portable CD player on her belt with headphones around her neck, a paperback folded open in one hand, a red pen in the other; front, profile, seated-reading pose; expression heads: dry, level, quietly furious, tender for one panel; labeled CHLOE 1998. Neat hand-lettered labels are allowed on this sheet.
jobs.negative: color, gray gradients, photorealistic, 3D render, smooth digital line, watermark, extra fingers
